rules.answer: The final TTL is 10 minutes (turn-26 overrides turn-17 and turn-4). A token is expired at exactly 10 minutes.
Throttle keys are the SHA-256 hex of the lowercased, trimmed address (turn-21); tokens are stored as SHA-256 hex hashes only (turn-3, turn-29).
No logout, no resend, no HTTP endpoints in this iteration (turn-23): only the two modules.
One email per address per 60 seconds; at exactly 60 seconds shouldSend returns true again.
Write Vitest tests under tests/auth for expiry boundaries, single use, hashing at rest and the throttle key.
